subject: reasoning
question: M is the son of N. N is the brother of O. O is the son of P. How is M related to P? ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) M is the son of N.

2) N is the brother of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f88656a4098b721b41a9db3319368f6716dd56bd8ad2a19ab3833511ec355bb5.png] 

3) O is the son of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f7107a34128cdcf1acd63393c7d65a6ee25cb19b4eb7ea8cef69f971b0d9af4.png] 

Thus, M is P's grandson.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
